objective: Implement POST /profiles/batch in app/api/profiles.py per contract C1 (per-id results, null for missing, 422 too_many_ids beyond 100), extending the existing test suite

frozen_contracts.spec: POST /profiles/batch body {ids: [str]} -> 200 {results: [{id, name} | null per id]}; more than 100 ids -> 422 error.code 'too_many_ids'

non_goals: Do not touch app/store.py (T03 owns it) or app/runtime_state.py (contextvars migration is a named Stage non-goal)
implementation_constraints: Batch beyond 100 ids returns 422 before any store read

acceptance_tests.description: 2 known + 1 unknown id returns 200 with 3 results, unknown = null
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_api.py::test_batch_mixed asserts result count 3 and null for p-x
pytest tests/test_api.py::test_batch_too_many asserts status 422 and code

failure_cases.scenario: store read raises for one id
failure_cases.expected_behavior: that id maps to null, other ids still return (per C1 per-id semantics)

handoff.notes: record the exact response field list in verified_facts for gate E1
